title: Decision dossier - model compatibility stories & procurement triage
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Purpose: Produce a decision-ready dossier that synthesizes competitive model behavior into customer-facing compatibility stories and a procurement triage rubric. This ticket scopes research, artifact collection, and an actionable prioritization rule set that sales, SRE, and procurement can use when a customer asks about model substitution or runway risk.

Scope:
- Gather empirical signals across latency, token-cost, output-stability, and API delta for 12 candidate open models and 3 vendor-hosted endpoints.
- Interview 6 customer-facing teams to collect three real customer scenarios where model switches were considered.
- Write 6 short compatibility stories (one-pagers) mapping customer workload to recommended fallback model flavors and expected trade-offs.
- Define a procurement triage rubric with thresholds (latency SLO, cost delta, API incompatibilities, legal/license blockers) and remedial playbooks (canary rollout cadence, prompt-slimming, quantization fallback).

Deliverables:
1) Decision dossier PDF + Confluence summary (single-page executive summary + technical appendix).
2) Compatibility story one-pagers (markdown in Drive).
3) Procurement triage rubric (spreadsheet + playbook).
4) Redlines for Console to surface the triage score per model (proposal for Console-2026.04 release).

Success metrics:
- 80% of sales calls with substitution discussions can be answered with a recommended fallback within 24 hours using artifacts from this dossier.
- Triage rubric produces consistent rank ordering (Kendall tau > 0.6) vs. manual expert ranking in a blind test of 30 scenarios.

Out of scope: long-term procurement negotiations, contractual template changes, implementation of Console UI changes (this ticket is the spec + prototype signals).
acceptance_criteria: Executive single-page summary uploaded to Confluence with links to appendices
